title: Backend staging stand-up: Supabase staging (AUTH #011), Vercel (#012), Inngest (#013) verified
summary: Verify the 2026-09-24 account setup end to end and bring STAGING to a usable state for M1: staging Supabase reachable with the .env.local URL + anon key, approved migrations applied with RLS on every table, auth settings per SECURITY_CHECKLIST §9.3, the Vercel and Inngest accounts usable, CI secrets present by name, and a repeatable staging smoke test. Production is never touched (production keys are CI-only, §1.4).
scope_out: Vercel project creation + API deploy and Inngest app sync (M1-PIPE-01, once the API has an HTTP handler and a staging Inngest environment exists).

acceptance_tests.test: Staging Supabase answers with the .env.local SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (auth health 200); the anon key and staging service-role key decode to the staging ref, never the production ref.
Every migration in supabase/migrations/ is applied to STAGING and recorded in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations; no pending migrations.

Every table in an app schema on STAGING has RLS enabled and at least one policy; a two-user + anon probe shows owner-only and published-read behave (other users and anon see only published+cleared rows; cross-user writes refused).
acceptance_tests.evidence: staging_smoke db.rls_every_table PASS + RLS probe in qa/reports/M1-PLAT-01.md §3

acceptance_tests.test: Auth settings: email sign-in with confirmation required, anonymous sign-in off, Apple and Google sign-in enabled (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §9.3).
The environment-urls edge function is deployed to STAGING with verify_jwt on (a call without a user JWT returns 401).
Vercel token and Inngest signing key authenticate read-only against their APIs; the state of the GJ Vercel project and Inngest app is recorded.
GitHub Actions secrets and variables needed for the backend exist (checked by name only); gaps and ambiguous duplicates are listed for the Owner.
No key, URL, password, or project ref appears in the repo or the evidence; secret-scan green.

history.event: created by gj-operator to track the backend staging stand-up (no existing ticket covered AUTH #011–#013 verification).

Verified staging: auth health 200; anon + staging service-role keys decode to the staging ref. Applied the AUTH #034 migration (20260926120000_m1_environments_staging) to STAGING via the session pooler in one transaction and recorded it in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations. Smoke 9 PASS / 0 FAIL / 3 PENDING (Apple, Google, edge-function deploy). Two-user + anon RLS probe (rolled back) passed. Vercel token + Inngest prod signing key authenticate; no GJ Vercel project and no Inngest app synced yet (deploy is M1-PIPE-01). GH secrets present by name, with ambiguous duplicates flagged. AT-1/2/3/6/7/8 met; AT-4/AT-5 blocked on the Owner. Evidence qa/reports/M1-PLAT-01.md.

Unblocked and all required ATs met. Apple and Google sign-in created and enabled on STAGING: Google Cloud project 'Gigantic Journeys' (consent screen External, Testing) with web client gj-supabase-staging; Apple Services ID com.sparkforgelabs.giganticjourneys.web.staging + Sign in with Apple key (Supabase client IDs = Services ID + bundle ID), client-secret JWT valid until 2027-03-26 (regenerate before then from SIWA_KEY_P8_BASE64). A staging-only SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN (Project Settings + Edge Functions) was added and environment-urls deployed to STAGING (verify_jwt on). An Inngest staging environment was created (INNGEST_STAGING_* secrets). Smoke 12 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 PENDING (AT-4, AT-5 met). Secrets by name only: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_STAGING, SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_SECRET, SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET, SIWA_KEY_P8_BASE64, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, INNGEST_STAGING_EVENT_KEY, INNGEST_STAGING_SIGNING_KEY; variables SIWA_KEY_ID, SIWA_SERVICES_ID_STAGING. Evidence qa/reports/M1-PLAT-01.md §9.
